static_traits.name: Wen Qiming
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with classmates and colleagues are tense due to lack of confidence
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no similar psychological problems in the past, nor psychotherapy yet
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly with coherent thinking; initially skeptical but willing to cooperate; can report thoughts and bodily reactions in detail

basic_info.main_problem: Since forgetting an important case file when practicing as a prosecutor, feelings of inadequacy and Persistent self-doubt about memory and ability as a future Lawyer have arisen, already affecting Learning and overall state.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent self-doubt and feelings of inadequacy have begun affecting my academic performance and overall health, which prompted me to seek counseling.

core_beliefs: I am not competent to become a Lawyer

special_situations.event: Forgot to bring an important case file in a prosecutor practical exercise
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make such a low-level mistake, it proves my ability is insufficient, my memory is poor, and I am not worthy of being a Lawyer
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using various memory techniques and self-comfort to prove I am not incompetent; avoiding continued practice in the short term
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I do not have enough memory to become a qualified Lawyer; this shows I am not good enough

special_situations.event: Making small mistakes in exams or practical exercises
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot achieve zero errors, I am doomed to fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Strong self-blame and temporarily stops studying or practicing to avoid making mistakes again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Made a stupid mistake again; I will never learn

special_situations.event: At night, repeatedly worries about making mistakes again and imagines consequences
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make a mistake once more, the consequences will be terrible; academics and career will be ruined
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly rehearsing and worrying in my mind in hopes of 'preventing mistakes', causing sleep to be disrupted
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Next time I will surely make mistakes again, and things will become terrible

special_situations.event: Thinking about talking to classmates or friends about my troubles, or having inadequacy seen during interactions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my inadequacy is exposed, others will look down on me and will not understand me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Not discussing these feelings with friends, reduced social contact to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am incompetent and unfit to be a Lawyer

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized as capable, reliable, and able to fill the Lawyer role
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged as incompetent, negated, and ultimately failing
defense_goal: Avoiding exposing flaws through self-criticism and Withdrawal
Buffering shame and Anxiety with rational Interpretation (pressure/technique)

object_relations.self_representation: An error-prone, unqualified Student / prospective Lawyer
object_relations.object_representation: Critical others who may not understand (classmates, colleagues, authority figures)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to review mistakes or discuss inadequate ability (e.g., exploring specific error scenarios in session)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: May see others/the counselor as judges, fearing exposed inadequacy will be looked down upon
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Describes events in an objective, analytical tone, emphasizing facts such as 'stress' and 'skills', downplaying feelings of shame and vulnerability, using few emotion words.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Feeling intense shame and Anxiety after making mistakes
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Internalizing possible external criticism as Self-denial, believing 'I am unworthy / not good enough'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-blaming language (e.g., 'It is all my fault' 'I am so terrible'), low tone, reducing interaction with others.

manifestations: Has a few close friends but has not yet talked to them about inadequacy and Self-doubt
Worrying others 'will not understand', tending to keep distance
Interpersonal relationships strained by lack of confidence

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Worrying friends 'will not understand', therefore not communicating
Assuming in social situations that others will look down on oneself

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequently using Self-denial statements (e.g., 'I am not good enough' 'I will never learn')
In sessions first expresses skepticism but cooperates cautiously, speaking carefully

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: Not seeking support from friends, choosing to digest it alone
Withdrawing actions and self-reproaching after mistakes

positive_force: Still willing to try recording and examining thoughts (retaining hope for change)
Able to identify trigger situations (small mistakes in exams/practice)
Having a certain support network (a few close friends to talk to)
Willing to cooperate with behavioral experiments and data collection
negative_force: Intense Self-doubt and feelings of inadequacy
Marked cognitive biases (black-and-white thinking, overgeneralization, predicting the future, mind reading)
Avoidance and withdrawal behaviors after mistakes maintain the problem cycle
Anxiety about making mistakes again leading to Sleep disturbed
Low confidence causing Interpersonal tension, and Social support not yet effectively utilized

target_behavior.behavior: Self-deprecating automatic thoughts (e.g., 'I will never learn' 'I am unfit to be a Lawyer')
antecedent: Making small mistakes in exams or practical exercises
Recalling the incident of forgetting the case file
target_behavior.core_reason: Core cognitive assumptions of black-and-white thinking and overgeneralization (equating one mistake with overall incompetence)
target_behavior.function: Self-defense (avoiding disappointment and shame from external evaluation by negating oneself first)
target_behavior.consequence: Heightened Low mood and Anxiety, further declining confidence, impaired attention and efficiency

target_behavior.behavior: Avoidance/withdrawal (stopping learning or avoiding continued practice after making mistakes)
antecedent: Palpitations, chest tightness and other Anxiety reactions after making mistakes
Anticipating making mistakes again and being negated
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and negative predictions about the future (believing another mistake means 'it is over')
target_behavior.function: Avoiding discomfort and short-term relief of Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased academic efficiency, slipping grades, Interpersonal tension, the problem cycle maintained and Reinforced

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep disturbed (ruminating out of worry about making mistakes again)
antecedent: Repeatedly thinks at night about mistakes in academics / practical work and possible consequences
target_behavior.core_reason: Predicting the future and catastrophizing cognitions maintain high arousal and rumination
target_behavior.function: Tries to 'prevent errors' through worry and rehearsal (an illusion of cognitive control)
target_behavior.consequence: Declining sleep quality, increased fatigue, impaired attention and memory the next day, further weakening performance and confidence
